## How to regenerate

```
make eval          # replay mode, no API key
make eval MODE=live
```

Output of the run above replaces every `—` in this file. Once populated, `evaluation/README.md` and the repo root `README.md` top-line scorecard are checked against this file by CI so they cannot silently go stale.
